purpose: Future civilization scenarios through explicit drivers, plural paths, distributive effects, institutions, and revisable present choices.
editorial_principles: Use a named jurisdiction, population, and date where applicable.
Present comparisons on equal terms and label illustrative scenarios.
Verify primary sources and current guidance before production.
Name horizon, geography, baseline, and choices. Scenarios are not predictions; global averages can hide inequity.
